blocks.html: Six student companies composed of graduating students taking BS Entrepreneurship from Siliman University will finally be able to test their business acumen as they take part of Robinsons Malls Entrep Corner from August 22 to September 21. This very special food bazaar will be participated by Alpha Company, which will introduce a new twist to meatballs; Grand Saveur takes a step forward offering their own newly blended taste of burgers and lumpia. For the health conscious, check out the combination of French crepes and Mexican taco, a healthy snack from Pantaco Co. Skewers Co. will sell mini kebabs at affordable prices. On the other hand, Arroz Tostado Co. serves a mix glutinous white and plain rice in savory flavors and varieties while Team Café de Wheels OA Smoothies will be offering 2 variants of smoothies: chocolate and strawberries. Robinsons Malls’ Entrep Corner is Robinsons Land Corporation’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program that aims to enhance the business skills of college students. For more queries, you may contact 397-1888 locals 791 and 792.
